test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Following is the figure showing the sales of different items of a stationery shop. Which product recorded the highest percentage change from 2020 to 2021?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/424cb88edfc007818684ac30649df79ef4f3644b10a128764b9e75cdb18fffb3.png]
solution:
**Solution:**

Percentage change from 2020 to 2021 in pen = (18 - 15)/15 × 100 = 20%

Percentage change from 2020 to 2021 in pencil = (21 - 16)/16 × 100 = 31.25%

Percentage change from 2020 to 2021 in notebook = (35 - 25)/25 × 100 = 40%

Percentage change from 2020 to 2021 in pages = (26 - 20)/20 × 100 = 30%

Percentage change from 2020 to 2021 in erasers = (24 - 18)/24 × 100 = 25%

Percentage change from 2020 to 2021 in chats = (37 - 27)/27 × 100 = 37.03%

Percentage change from 2020 to 2021 in geometry = (44 - 32)/32 × 100 = 37.5%

Notebook recorded the highest percentage change from 2020 to 2021

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
